subsection.content: Subject to subsection (2), this Regulation comes into operation on the day on which section 5 of the Fire Services (Amendment) Ordinance 2017 (1 of 2017) comes into operation.
The Schedule (except item 3 of Part 1) comes into operation on a day to be appointed by the Secretary for Security by notice published in the Gazette.

section.name: s2
section.heading: Interpretation

authorized officer (獲授權人員) means a public officer appointed to be an authorized officer under section 92(1), and includes the Director;

def.name: Class

paragraph.name: a

paragraph.name: b

paragraph.name: c

def.name: FireSafetyCertificate
def.leadIn: fire safety certificate (消防安全證明書) means—

section.def: fire safety (fire service installation) certificate (消防安全(消防裝置)證明書), in relation to any scheduled premises, means a certificate certifying the premises’ compliance with all relevant fire safety requirements issued in relation to the premises (other than those relating to the ventilating system of the premises);

fire safety requirement (消防安全規定), in relation to any scheduled premises, means any requirement, specified by the Director or relevant licensing authority, relating to fire safety that has to be met for the purposes of a specified application to which the premises relate, and includes a requirement that is issued under section 27(1)(c) for the premises;

fire safety (ventilating system) certificate (消防安全(通風系統)證明書), in relation to any scheduled premises, means a certificate certifying the premises’ compliance with all relevant fire safety requirements issued in relation to the premises relating to the ventilating system of the premises;

paragraph.name: b

paragraph.name: b

section.name: s3
section.heading: Holding oneself out as registered fire engineer

subsection.leadIn: A person who is not a registered fire engineer must not— (L.N. 207 of 2025)

paragraph.name: a
b
paragraph.content: knowingly permit himself or herself to be advertised or represented as a registered fire engineer (whether or not for any specific class), or in a misleading title; or

paragraph.name: c
paragraph.content: wilfully or falsely hold out in any way intended to cause, or that may reasonably cause, another person to believe that the person is a registered fire engineer (whether or not for any specific class).

subsection.name: 1A
subsection.leadIn: A person who is a registered fire engineer for a certain class must not—

paragraph.name: a
b
c
paragraph.content: wilfully or falsely hold out in any way intended to cause, or that may reasonably cause, another person to believe that the person is a registered fire engineer for such other class. (L.N. 207 of 2025)

subsection.content: A person who contravenes subsection (1) or (1A) commits an offence and is liable on conviction to a fine at level 5 and to imprisonment for 1 year.

subsection.leadIn: In this section—

def.name: MisleadingTitle
def.leadIn: misleading title (誤導職銜), in relation to a person, means a title (however described) of the person that is capable of causing another person to falsely believe— (L.N. 207 of 2025)

paragraph.name: a
b
paragraph.content: if the person is a registered fire engineer for a certain class—that the person is a registered fire engineer for another class for which the person is not registered.

section.name: s4
section.heading: Prohibition on issue of fire safety requirements or fire safety certificates

subsection.leadIn: A person must not issue any fire safety requirement or fire safety certificate for a specified application in relation to any scheduled premises unless the person—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: is a registered fire engineer for the relevant class; or

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: is empowered under any other enactment to issue such a requirement or certificate.

subsection.content: A person who contravenes subsection (1) commits an offence and is liable on conviction to a fine at level 6 and to imprisonment for 1 year.
A person may apply to the Director for registration as a registered fire engineer for one or more classes.
The application must be accompanied by the prescribed fee.

section.name: s6
section.heading: Appointment of interview board
section.content: On receiving an application made under section 5, the Director may appoint a board to consider the application.

subsection.content: If an applicant is invited to attend an interview before an interview board for consideration of the application, the applicant must attend the interview.

subsection.leadIn: If the applicant fails to attend the interview, the interview board may—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: if satisfied that the failure was due to sickness or any other reasonable cause—adjourn the interview to another time; or

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: in any other case—proceed to make a recommendation without an interview.

subsection.leadIn: An interview board must make a recommendation in writing to the Director on whether or not an application made under section 5 should be approved—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: after conducting an interview in relation to the application; or

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: without any interview if section 7(2)(b) applies.

subsection.content: However, the Director is not bound by the recommendation.

subsection.leadIn: The Director may—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: approve an application made by an applicant under section 5 in respect of any or all classes applied for; or

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: subject to subsection (3), refuse the application, but only if the Director considers it inappropriate to approve the application.

subsection.leadIn: Without limiting the meaning of “inappropriate” in subsection (1)(b), the Director may consider it inappropriate to approve the application if the Director is not satisfied that the applicant meets both of the following criteria—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: the applicant has met the applicable requirements for registration specified in Division 6;

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: the applicant is a fit and proper person who may be registered as a registered fire engineer for the relevant class.

subsection.leadIn: If the Director intends to refuse the application, the Director—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: must give the applicant written notice of the intention and reasons for the refusal;

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: must not refuse the application until the expiry of a 30-day period beginning on the date immediately following the date of the notice; and

paragraph.name: c
paragraph.content: if the applicant makes any representations, in the way specified in the notice, within that period to support the application—must consider the representations before making a decision on the application.

subsection.leadIn: However, if the applicant is subject to a removal order—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: the Director must refuse the application; and

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: subsection (3) does not apply to the refusal.

subsection.content: On approving the application, the Director may impose any condition considered appropriate.

subsection.leadIn: After approving the application, the Director must, subject to the applicant’s payment of the prescribed fee—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: register the applicant as a registered fire engineer for the relevant class and enter the applicant’s name in the register accordingly; and

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: issue a registration card specifying the date on which the registration takes effect to the applicant for the class for which the applicant is registered.

subsection.content: A registration under this section is, subject to an earlier removal of name under section 15, valid for 5 years beginning on the date referred to in subsection (6)(b).
In deciding whether an applicant is a fit and proper person under section 9(2)(b), the Director may take into account any factors that the Director considers appropriate.

subsection.leadIn: Without limiting subsection (1), the Director may consider—

subparagraph.content: convicted in Hong Kong or elsewhere of any offence which, if committed by a registered fire engineer, may bring the profession of registered fire engineer into disrepute; or
sentenced to imprisonment in Hong Kong or elsewhere, whether suspended or not; and

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: whether the applicant has committed any misconduct or neglect in a professional respect.

subsection.content: A person who is a registered fire engineer may apply to the Director for renewal of the person’s registration for any or all classes for which the person is registered as such an engineer.

subsection.leadIn: The application—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: must be accompanied by the prescribed fee; and

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: must be made not more than 4 months but not less than 1 month before the existing registration expires.

subsection.leadIn: The Director may—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: approve the application; or

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: subject to subsection (5), refuse the application, but only if the Director considers it inappropriate to approve the application.

subsection.content: Without limiting the meaning of “inappropriate” in subsection (3)(b), the Director may consider it inappropriate to approve the application if the Director is not satisfied that the applicant meets both of the criteria referred to in section 9(2)(a) and (b).

subsection.leadIn: If the Director intends to refuse the application, the Director—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: must give the applicant written notice of the intention and reasons for the refusal;

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: must not refuse the application until the expiry of a 30-day period beginning on the date immediately following the date of the notice; and

paragraph.name: c
paragraph.content: if the applicant makes any representations, in the way specified in the notice, within that period to support the application—must consider the representations before making a decision on the application.

subsection.leadIn: However, if the applicant is subject to a removal order—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: the Director must refuse the application; and

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: subsection (5) does not apply to the refusal.

subsection.leadIn: If the Director approves the application, the Director may—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: amend or remove any condition of registration previously imposed; and

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: impose any new condition as the Director considers appropriate.

subsection.leadIn: After approving the application, the Director must, subject to the applicant’s payment of the prescribed fee—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: renew the applicant’s registration as a registered fire engineer for the relevant class; and

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: issue a registration card specifying the date on which the renewal takes effect to the applicant for the class for which the applicant is registered.

section.name: s12
section.heading: Effect of existing registration pending Director’s decision

subsection.content: This section applies if the Director has not made a decision on an application made under section 11 before the day on which the existing registration is due to expire (expiry day).
If the application is made not less than 1 month before the expiry day, the existing registration is taken to continue in effect until the day on which the Director has made the decision.

subsection.leadIn: Despite section 11(2), if the application is made less than 1 month before the expiry day—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: the Director may process the application if the Director considers there is a good reason for doing so; and

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: the existing registration ceases to have effect on that day even though the Director is still considering the application.

subsection.leadIn: In this section—
subsection.def: existing registration (現有註冊), in relation to an application made under section 11, means the registration as a registered fire engineer that the application seeks to renew.

section.name: s13
section.heading: Effective date of renewal
section.leadIn: A renewal of registration (existing registration) under section 11 is, subject to an earlier removal of name under section 15, valid for 5 years—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: if the Director approves the application for renewal before the existing registration expires—beginning on the date immediately after the expiry of the existing registration; or

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.leadIn: if the Director approves the application for renewal after the existing registration expires—

subparagraph.content: where the application is made not less than 1 month before the existing registration expires—despite section 12(2), beginning on the date immediately after the expiry of the existing registration; or
where the application is made less than 1 month before the existing registration expires—beginning on the date on which the Director’s decision of approval of renewal takes effect.

subsection.leadIn: The Director may, on application by a registered fire engineer, issue to the engineer a registration card (replacement card) to replace the engineer’s original registration card (original card) if—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: there is a change in the name of the engineer; or

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: if the original card is in hard copy form—the card is lost, destroyed, defaced or damaged.

subsection.leadIn: When making an application under subsection (1), the registered fire engineer must—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: pay the prescribed fee; and

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: if the original card is in hard copy form and is in the possession of the engineer—return the card to the Director.

subsection.content: The Director may refuse to issue a replacement card to the registered fire engineer if the engineer fails to comply with subsection (2).
A replacement card issued under subsection (1) has the same effect as, and is equivalent to, the original card.
On the issue of a replacement card, the original card ceases to be valid.
The Director must remove a person’s name from the register if satisfied that one or more of the grounds specified in section 16(1) applies to the person.
Subject to subsection (4), the Director must remove a person’s name from the register if satisfied that one or more of the grounds specified in section 16(2) applies to the person. (L.N. 207 of 2025)

subsection.leadIn: If a person’s name is removed from the register because of the ground specified in section 16(1)(b), the person must not make an application under section 5 or 11 during—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: in the case of a permanent removal—a period specified by the Director; or

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: in the case of a temporary removal—the period during which the removal order has effect.

subsection.leadIn: Subject to subsection (5), if the Director intends to remove a person’s name from the register because of a ground specified in section 16(2)(c), (d), (e), (f) or (g), the Director—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: must give the person written notice of the intention to remove the person’s name;

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: must not remove the person’s name until the expiry of a 30-day period beginning on the date immediately following the date of the notice; and

paragraph.name: c
paragraph.content: if the person makes any representations, in the way specified in the notice, within that period in respect of the intended removal—must consider the representations before making a decision on the removal.

subsection.content: Subsection (4) does not apply if the Director considers that it is in the public interest to immediately remove the person’s name from the register.

Unless the removal is because of the ground specified in section 16(2)(a), the Director must, as soon as practicable after removing a person’s name from the register under this section, notify the person in writing.
The notice must state the period mentioned in subsection (3)(a) or (b) (if applicable).

subsection.leadIn: A notice of intention to remove under subsection (4) and a notice under subsection (6)—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: must set out the ground for the removal; and

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: must state the date on which the removal is intended to take effect or takes effect (as appropriate).

subsection.leadIn: The following grounds are specified for the purposes of section 15(1)—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: the Director has refused an application made by the person for renewal of the person’s registration under section 11;

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: a removal order has effect against the person.

subsection.leadIn: The following grounds are specified for the purposes of section 15(2)—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: the person has died;

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: the person has applied to discontinue the person’s registration as a registered fire engineer;

paragraph.name: c
paragraph.content: the person has not renewed the person’s registration under section 11;

paragraph.name: d
paragraph.content: the person has ceased to hold the qualification by virtue of which the person became a registered fire engineer;

paragraph.name: e
paragraph.leadIn: at the time of the person’s application to be registered as a registered fire engineer—

subparagraph.content: the person in fact did not meet the applicable requirements for registration specified in Division 6; or
the person was in fact not a fit and proper person who may be registered as a registered fire engineer for the relevant class;

paragraph.name: f
paragraph.content: the person has ceased to be a fit and proper person who may be registered as a registered fire engineer for the relevant class; (L.N. 207 of 2025)

paragraph.name: g
paragraph.content: the person is convicted of a criminal offence under this Regulation.

section.name: s17
section.heading: Effective date of removal
section.leadIn: For the purposes of section 15(8)(b), a removal of a person’s name takes effect—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: if on the ground specified in section 16(1)(a) or (2)(c)—on the date immediately after the expiry of the existing registration;

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: if on the ground specified in section 16(1)(b)—on the date of the removal order; or

paragraph.name: c
paragraph.content: if on the ground specified in section 16(2)(b), (d), (e), (f) or (g)—on the date stated in the notice under section 15(8)(b).

subsection.content: If a person ceases to hold the qualification by virtue of which the person is registered, the person must notify the Director in writing within 14 days after the date on which the person ceases to hold the qualification.
A person who, without reasonable excuse, contravenes subsection (1) commits an offence and is liable on conviction to a fine at level 3.
This section applies to an application made under this Part.

subsection.leadIn: The application—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: must be made in the form and way specified by the Director; and

subparagraph.content: any document or information specified by the Director; and
the prescribed fee.

subsection.content: If a person obtains registration as a registered fire engineer for the person or any other person by means of any misleading, false or fraudulent representation or statement (whether oral or in writing), the person commits an offence and is liable on conviction to a fine at level 5 and to imprisonment for 1 year.

section.name: s20
section.heading: Notification of reasons for refusal
section.content: If the Director refuses an application made under this Part, the Director must notify the applicant in writing of the reasons for the refusal.

section.name: s21
section.heading: Different requirements for different classes of registered fire engineers

subsection.leadIn: This section applies to a person who applies for—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: registration as a registered fire engineer for a certain class; or

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: renewal of registration as a registered fire engineer for a certain class.

subsection.content: The applicant must meet the applicable requirements specified in section 22, 23 or 24 for the class to which the application relates.

section.name: s22
section.heading: Requirements for registered fire engineer (risk assessment)

subsection.leadIn: The requirements for registering as a registered fire engineer (risk assessment) or renewing a registration as a registered fire engineer (risk assessment) are—

subparagraph.content: is a registered professional engineer under the Engineers Registration Ordinance who is in the fire discipline; and
has at least 1 year of relevant working experience;

subparagraph.leadIn: holds a bachelor degree in any of the following disciplines—

subparagraph.name: A
subparagraph.content: fire engineering;

subparagraph.name: B
subparagraph.content: building services engineering;

subparagraph.name: C
subparagraph.content: mechanical engineering;

subparagraph.name: D
subparagraph.content: civil engineering;

subparagraph.name: E
subparagraph.content: structural engineering;

subparagraph.name: F
subparagraph.content: building surveying; and
has at least 6 years of relevant working experience;
holds any academic qualification recognized by the Director as equivalent to, or higher than, any of the qualifications mentioned in paragraph (b)(i); and
has at least 6 years of relevant working experience; or

attains, as recognized by the Director on the advice of an interview board, a level of competence meeting the standard that is equivalent to, or higher than, that represented by any of the qualifications mentioned in paragraph (b)(i); and
has at least 15 years of relevant working experience.

subsection.leadIn: To meet the requirements of subsection (1)(b) (other than subsection (1)(b)(i)(A)), (c) or (d), the applicant must show—

subparagraph.content: the courses specified by the Director in relation to the class for which the applicant seeks to be registered; or
other courses recognized by the Director as equivalent; or

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: that equivalent content has been covered in the bachelor degree programme taken by the applicant.
